objectiveDefects.problem: The 328-session, 126-named-credential and 704-artifact figures were not reconciled, so a reader could not audit the number chain.
objectiveDefects.requiredRepair: Explain that 328 counts affected session files, 704 counts separate sensitive items in genuine-user sessions, and one session can contain several items.

qualityFindings.finding: The mechanism and practical action were strong, but long stretches read as neutral security journalism rather than LAiDIES.
The role-specific advice for ordinary users, log publishers and already-exposed credentials produced a genuine useful reader change.

boundary: Role-distinct model judgment only. No observed unfamiliar-human evidence, visual admission, canonical write, deployment or publication authority.
